description: This file defines the TwitterSettings class for managing Twitter API integration within the ERPNext framework, including OAuth authentication, posting, deleting, and retrieving tweets.

classes.name: TwitterSettings
classes.description: A class for managing Twitter API interactions, including OAuth authentication, posting, deleting, and fetching tweets.

methods.name: get_authorize_url
methods.description: Generates the Twitter OAuth authorization URL for user authentication.

methods.name: get_access_token
methods.description: Retrieves and stores the access token after OAuth callback.

methods.name: get_api
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Tweepy API object with current credentials.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts a tweet with optional media.

methods.name: upload_image
methods.description: Uploads an image to Twitter and returns the media ID.

methods.name: send_tweet
methods.description: Sends a tweet with optional media ID.

methods.name: api_error
methods.description: Handles API errors, updates session status, and raises exceptions.
